#selfhosted So I am trying to set up a Nextcloud instance on a VPS server I have rented out for the next year. And it's quite a trek through a maze of security. At least I'm familiar with Linux.

I just want a space I can share with family for various files and pics, and I got a domain name for my own email server - outside Google. 

But now that I got an email with tuta, I wonder if getting a syncthing with the kids wouldn't be just as efficient, since I have libre office anyways.
